post.caption:
Sea otters eat urchins, urchins eat kelp, and without otters the kelp forest disappears. Same story with beavers as engineers, elephants keeping savannah open, and fig trees feeding a whole rainforest. Importance has nothing to do with abundance. A rare species can be load-bearing while a common one is not.
